title: 心跳超时与欠副本块的自动复制恢复
expected_output:
dead_node: dn3
under_replicated_before: {'blk2': ['dn1', 'dn2']}
replication_actions: [('blk1', ['dn4']), ('blk2', ['dn4']), ('blk3', ['dn1'])]
blk1 replicas: ['dn1', 'dn2', 'dn4'] count: 3
blk2 replicas: ['dn1', 'dn2', 'dn4'] count: 3
blk3 replicas: ['dn2', 'dn4', 'dn1'] count: 3
code:
blocks = {
    "blk1": ["dn1", "dn2", "dn3"],
    "blk2": ["dn1", "dn2"],
    "blk3": ["dn2", "dn3", "dn4"],
}
alive = {"dn1", "dn2", "dn4"}   # dn3 心跳超时判死
REP = 3
def rereplicate(blocks, alive, rep):
    actions = []
    for blk, dns in blocks.items():
        live = [d for d in dns if d in alive]
        if len(live) < rep:
            need = rep - len(live)
            cands = [d for d in alive if d not in live]
            actions.append((blk, cands[:need]))
            blocks[blk] = live + cands[:need]
    return actions
print("dead_node: dn3")
print("under_replicated_before:", {b: blocks[b] for b in blocks if len(blocks[b]) < REP})
acts = rereplicate(blocks, alive, REP)
print("replication_actions:", acts)
for b in sorted(blocks):
    print(b, "replicas:", blocks[b], "count:", len(blocks[b]))
